Gathered the SOP and insurer policy, the case record (3 documents, 1 notes) and 1 team-knowledge entry (KB-0002)
Asked claude-opus-5-5 for the next step
Reading the denial and where the case stands

result.situation: CASE-1103: Dupixent for adult atopic dermatitis, Northwind Commercial. First denial (ST-NOTMET) on 2026-10-12 because no topical calcineurin inhibitor (TCI) trial was documented. On 2026-10-14 the prescriber sent a signed letter stating TCIs are contraindicated due to recurrent eczema herpeticum. The window closes 2026-11-11, with 567h left.

criteria.criterion: Diagnosis: moderate-to-severe AD with IGA ≥3 or BSA ≥10%
criteria.evidence: PA form lists L20.9, IGA 3 and BSA 15%.

criteria.criterion: Prescriber is a dermatologist, allergist or immunologist
criteria.evidence: Dr. Hannah Okafor is listed as Allergy & Immunology.

criteria.criterion: Step 3a: medium-to-super-high-potency TCS for ≥28 consecutive days, documented with drug, dates and outcome
criteria.evidence: Fluocinonide 0.05% ointment 04/01/2026–05/15/2026, inadequate response, per the PA form and office email. The denial cited only the TCI step. The TCS potency class is not stated in the sources, and no chart notes are on file.

criteria.criterion: Step 3b: TCI for ≥28 days, or contraindication/intolerance (step-therapy exception via LMN)
criteria.evidence: No TCI was trialed. A signed prescriber letter states TCIs are contraindicated given three eczema herpeticum episodes, the last in 06/2026 requiring IV acyclovir. The policy accepts an LMN documenting a contraindication.

criteria.criterion: No concurrent biologic or JAK inhibitor for AD
criteria.evidence: PA form states no concurrent biologic or JAK inhibitor.

missing_information.item: Chart notes documenting the fluocinonide trial (drug, dates, outcome)
missing_information.why_it_matters: Policy requires step trials to be documented in chart notes. Currently only the PA form and a front-desk email support it.
missing_information.how_to_get: Request the relevant visit notes from Metro Allergy Partners in parallel.

missing_information.item: Confirmation that the patient named in the office email matches PT-64330
missing_information.why_it_matters: The email names the patient, but the case record holds only a reference number.
missing_information.how_to_get: Match the name and DOB against the case system demographics before attaching.

E1.reason: No Forus clinical judgment is needed. The prescriber's signed letter (DOC-1103-02) itself declares the TCI contraindication, which POLICY accepts for an exception.

E2.reason: DOC-1103-01, DOC-1103-02, DOC-1103-03 and NOTE-1 agree on the trials and the history.

E3.reason: No rule change is claimed. KB-0002 concerns triamcinolone, which is not relevant here. POLICY bulletin NW-B-2026-09 shows no changes.

E4.reason: 567h are left per system facts (CASE window 2026-11-11), well over 48h.

E5.reason: This is the first denial; submission_count is 1 (CASE).

E6.reason: Eczema herpeticum is past history and the basis of the contraindication (DOC-1103-02). No current safety concern is reported.

result.action_rationale: The ST-NOTMET denial was for the TCI step only. The prescriber's signed letter documents a contraindication, and POLICY accepts a step-therapy exception with an LMN documenting one. No triggers fire, and there is ample time in the window.
parallel_actions: Request chart notes for the fluocinonide trial from Metro Allergy Partners to strengthen the file.
Log the criteria checklist in case notes per SOP step 6.
could_not_determine: Whether the payer classifies fluocinonide 0.05% as medium-to-super-high potency (not stated in sources; denial did not dispute it).
Whether the brief prescriber letter meets Northwind's LMN format expectations.
needs_human_judgment: Confirm the signed letter is sufficient as the LMN, or ask the office for a fuller LMN.
Decide whether to submit now or wait briefly for TCS chart notes.

draft.subject: CASE-1103 – Step-therapy exception request, Dupixent (dupilumab) 300 mg q2w, atopic dermatitis
draft.body:
Re: CASE-1103, Dupixent (dupilumab) 300 mg q2w for moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis (policy NW-RX-2207). Prescriber: Dr. Hannah Okafor, Allergy & Immunology, Metro Allergy Partners.

The request was denied 2026-10-12 as step therapy not met (no TCI trial). We request a step-therapy exception for the TCI requirement on the basis of a documented contraindication.

- Contraindication: the patient has recurrent eczema herpeticum (three episodes, most recent 06/2026, requiring IV acyclovir). The prescriber states TCIs are contraindicated. Signed letter of medical necessity attached.
- TCS step: fluocinonide 0.05% ointment 04/01/2026–05/15/2026, inadequate response.
- Severity: IGA 3, BSA 15%.
- No concurrent biologic or JAK inhibitor.

Attachments: prescriber letter of medical necessity (received 2026-10-14) and original PA request form.

Please approve the initial 6-month authorization. Thank you.

operator_summary.headline: Submit step-therapy exception with prescriber's letter
why: Denial was only for the missing calcineurin inhibitor trial.
Prescriber's signed letter states that drug class is contraindicated.
Payer accepts exceptions with such a letter; weeks remain.
then: Confirm the patient name in the office email matches.
Ask the office for chart notes on the steroid trial.
Log the criteria checklist in case notes.
